sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply the exact word 'schemes' in 'fruit of their own ___'. Nothing on the earlier cards lets a baker reason to that word, and the wrong answers 'fields' and 'prayers' are only filler. This is guessing the wording of a line.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: This joke repeats the punchline shape of the joke on card 8, which also starts 'That's me [doing a cookie thing]'. The same shape is used twice in one lesson. The joke also puts Papa Dorin in the refiner's seat, heating the batch, while the refining in the verse is the LORD's work.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.

sonnet.problem: The setup line says 'The refining doesn't work on the LORD's people.' That rules out the wrong answer 'Purified silver', so the baker can eliminate it without knowing the passage.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
